proofReview.barrierLowerBound: Each finalcolorc position must receive a colorc stroke. One such stroke cannot cover finalc positions separated by a lighter finalcolor, since that intervening position could never be restored. Thus each color component separated by lighter barriers requires a distinctc stroke; different colors require different strokes.
proofReview.construction: For each samecolor link component, its leftmost..rightmost span contains no lighter FINAL color. Process components in increasing color and paint each span once. Earlier actual colors are<=current so strokes are legal; no later darker component can cover a lighter final target, by the same span property. Every final target is reached, using exactly one stroke per component, entirely inside a query.
proofReview.equalityAndForest: Eligible direct links require equal endpoints and strictly darker interior, including the vacuous adjacent case. Intermediate equal occurrences divide the direct pair into consecutive links. Each color graph is a monotone occurrence path; all colors form a forest, giving vertices minus internal edges.
proofReview.queryRestriction: An increasing-index occurrence path cannot leave an index interval and reenter. The global forest induced by a query interval equals the graph formed inside that interval. No use of external painting is needed. Our additional FULL-board BFS explicitly keeps all outside positions blank, verifying this independently of subarray slicing.
proofReview.stack: Retains strictly increasing distinct colors and the newest occurrence not blocked by a later lighter color. Pop only>, replacing the equal top after emitting its link. An encountered lighter value invalidates every larger candidate forever. Each position enters once and is popped/replaced once; all eligible links are emitted once.
proofReview.fenwickAndEmptyRanges: At sweependR, all registered links have right<R and therefore left<R. Subtractprefix(L) fromtotal tokeep left>=L, exactly both endpoints in[L,R). ForL=R all registered left<L, so total=prefix(L) and answer0; forN0, onlyend0 is processed and no add/color access occurs. Rightendpoint buckets retain original query indices and linked lists always point to earlier IDs.
proofReview.integerAndBounds: All sizes checked<=200000 before int casts; all queries checked before allocation, including empty and later invalid queries. n+1<=200001. Fenwick add begins at>=1 and nextindex<=262144, so i&-i never negatesINT_MIN or increments beyond explicit intmax>=1000000. Tree values/prefix/total/internal/answers<=N, validated endpoint subtraction bounded. ColorINT64_MIN/MAX only compared with>and==; unpainted is separate semantic state, no numeric sentinel.
proofReview.apiAndMemory: All original inputs included; arbitrary signedint64 colors, emptyN/Q/intervals are explicit extensions. Both inputvectors const, no mutation, global cache, external symbol, or recursion. Standard allocation failures unwind local buffers. Requested element payload3N+2Q+2 int slots with exact-request reserve as tested; at4byteint maximum4000008bytes excluding caller inputs/metadata/allocator/capacity policy. TimeO(N+Q+(N+Q)log(N+1)), includingN0.
